name: Penpie Pendle-market reward reentrancy (Arbitrum)
summary: The Arbitrum PendleStakingSideChain (same defect as Ethereum) harvested rewards from a permissionlessly registered Pendle market without a shared reentrancy guard, so the attacker re-entered depositMarket() during batchHarvestMarketRewards() to double-count its LP entitlement and withdrew Penpie's staked gUSDC-market Pendle LP as reward.
notes: The final pre-incident Upgraded(address) event reselected PendleStakingSideChain implementation 0xc64b3f60024b57d25246a6fecf2aa1260eae5b71 (10th and last Upgraded event before the incident).

Arbitrum-only gross victim depletion, measured from the single successful drain receipt 0x67c5400d. The drain is an atomic flash-borrow: the attacker contract 0x4bc9815b borrows 621667.936099 gUSDC from Balancer (0xba1222...), mints SY-gUSDC and Pendle LP, deposits the LP into PendleStaking proxy 0x6db96bbeb, re-enters depositMarket during harvest to double-count, withdraws twice the deposited LP (its own plus an equal slice of Penpie's inventory), redeems it and repays the flash loan. The flash loan nets to zero within the receipt, so the attack contract's end-of-tx net positive balance is the extraction: 616348.200200 gUSDC plus 114673.157598 YT-gUSDC. Proxy 0x6db96bbeb's net outflow of 330469.756983 gUSDC-market PENDLE-LPT (0xa877a0e1) reconciles with these redemptions. The USD total values only the liquid gUSDC (a Gains Network yield-bearing USDC vault token) at its DefiLlama pre-incident price of 1.10 (observation 1725382691, before the drain); the paired YT-gUSDC is recorded with exact quantity but null USD because it is a decaying, thinly traded yield token, so the figure is a slight lower bound. This Arbitrum leg is separate from and not duplicated in the Ethereum record (eip155:1:0x56e09abb...); together they make up the reported ~$27M-$28M cross-chain campaign. Later Penpie recovery negotiations are not netted.

The USD total values only the liquid gUSDC at its DefiLlama incident price; the paired YT-gUSDC the attacker also kept is recorded with exact quantity but null USD, so the measured figure is a slight lower bound.
